invariant: The queue translates the whole composed stereotype/label block by margin5. Each stripe baseline is block origin plus preceding heights plus its own ascent.
causal_divergence: The caller supplies base-font ascent, then ParticipantTextBlock subtracts actual first ascent. Rich first lines shift the entire label upward.
planned_change: Derive queue label and stereotype baselines at the component paint origin from their own measured first ascent; use existing complete text blocks, not a correction added after painting.
perturbation_axes: rich first versus later stripe with large/small sizes
